prompt: The attached image is the approved master of this exact character: keep EXACTLY the same face, hair, headband, armour, colours, proportions, body size and sword design; only the pose changes. Draw the pose described below, not the standing pose of the attached image. Single game hero sprite: A powerful battle-hardened human swordsman warrior, a serious, powerful, mature fighter, not cute, not childlike, not a mascot, about 4 heads tall with a normal-sized head (the head is only about one quarter of his height), broad squared shoulders, a deep strong chest, a narrow waist, thick strong forearms and thighs, a wide confident stance. TWO ARMS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH and TWO LEGS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH. A hard, grim face: a heavy straight brow line, a narrow eye slit, a firm flat mouth line, a strong square jaw, short cropped dark hair swept back, one short amber headband. He wears light close-fitting armour made of a few big angular flat plates: a blue-grey breastplate with a sharp V-shaped centre, angular shoulder guards (pauldrons) of the same size on both shoulders, a bracer on EACH forearm (identical on both arms), a short plate skirt, and a greave and boot on EACH leg (identical), one amber belt, an amber trim line on the shoulder guards; a short dark blue-grey cape that falls from the shoulders to his knees BEHIND him, seen only as a darker angular shape peeking out at both sides of his body, never in front of the arms. The weapon is ONE medium-length single-edged curved sword (a dao), the blade about as long as from his waist to his knee, pale steel with a thin amber edge line and an amber hilt wrap, long enough to read clearly but shorter than his legs. POSE A of a two-part attack, SIDE VIEW: his whole body is turned SIDEWAYS, a pure profile facing RIGHT (the face looking to the right, only one eye visible, the near shoulder toward the viewer). Both feet planted on ONE horizontal ground line, a medium-wide stance, knees only slightly bent, the torso leaning back a little to load the strike. BOTH ARMS are raised straight up above his head, the two forearms and the two fists of the SAME size, BOTH fists gripping the sword hilt together at the top, one fist right above the other, elbows bent and open. The sword is held in a reverse grip: the hilt is at the top between the fists and the BLADE POINTS STRAIGHT DOWN toward the ground, hanging just BEHIND his head and back (on the LEFT side of the image), the curved edge facing backward, the tip ending about at shoulder-blade height, clear of the head. The short cape hangs straight down BEHIND his back (on the LEFT side of the image), clearly behind the body. Both arms visible, neither hidden. Full body, centered, the whole figure including the raised fists and the sword inside the frame, filling about 75% of the frame height. No buckles, no pouches, no rope, no bandages, no spikes, no stitches, no fabric texture: armour is a few big flat angular plates with sharp corners. At most three colour families. NO effects of any kind: no slash trail, no motion lines, no glow, no dust, no sparks, no impact ring, no shadow on the ground. The character, the sword and the cape stay inside the frame with margin on every side. Background: one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no ground, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no border. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere on the subject. Stylized 2D vector game-character art for a top-down fantasy tower defense game, designed to read at about 60 pixels tall. Simple design: big clear shapes and a strong silhouette; small details are left out or merged into larger shapes; faces, hands, armour and clothing are suggested with a few lines, never rendered in fine detail. Stylized, exaggerated game-character proportions, not realistic anatomy and never chibi: the parts that express the character's role (shoulders, chest, forearms, sword) are enlarged so the silhouette reads at 60 pixels. Colour: flat solid fills only, no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no noise, no realistic rendering. Volume and shadow come from 2-3 hard-edged tones of the same colour (shadow, base, light), plus a few small highlight shapes. Thick clean outlines in a dark shade of the neighbouring colour. High top-down camera tilted about 60 degrees; light comes from the top-left.
